clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Delivery FCA; standard lead time 56 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. opens a new moulding line

documents.subject: Payment terms for stainless castings
documents.author: Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.
documents.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
the start-up of our new moulding line has tied up more cash than we planned, and our bank is watching our figures closely. To keep alloy material flowing we kindly ask our customers to pay within 10 days from November. We are working hard on the porosity issue and will report on our corrective actions.
Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

documents.subject: Supplier day
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: At our supplier day Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.

documents.subject: Payment of invoices
documents.author: Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.
documents.text: Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

persona.summary: Czech family foundry (150 staff, EUR 8.3 M), we are 2.4 % of its turnover and growing 30 %. The new moulding line (Apr 2026) tied up more cash than planned: its bank tightened the credit line (Oct 2026) and is watching its figures, and it asks customers to pay within 10 days from November. Calls Hollerau an important reference customer. Holds only 25 % of Volute casing HI 80-250; 70180 has 75 % (at a higher 654.52). Quality slipping: ppm 5682, red Q3, porosity issue admitted. Trade 10-day payment and volume for price.
persona.notes: Cash-short after the moulding-line start-up; bank tightened its credit line. Wants 10-day payment and volume for the new line; fears losing the 25 % share to 70180 and its bank. Admits a porosity issue. We pay 5.5 days late on average.

levers: binding volume for the new moulding line
arguments: 10-day payment worth more to it than price now
volume shift from co-source 70180 (70180 is dearer, no rival-price argument)
quality record: ppm 5682, red Q3, porosity issue it admits
avoid: faster payment without a price step in return
changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Open deep: it gave way fully in past renewals, we have 70180 at 75 %, and it needs cash now.
Offer payment within 10 days, as its letter asks, only in exchange for a price step.
Offer more quota from 70180 as binding volume for its new line in exchange for price.
Cite the red Q3 scorecard (5682 ppm) and its porosity issue as a separate argument.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; past renewals settled below even its own offers (kept share -0.16), and bank pressure makes cash terms worth a price step.
